package answer

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// InProcessAnswerInput represents payload from external service.
type InProcessAnswerInput struct {
	AnswerID      string
	FileStorageID string
	StudentID     string
	UserRole      string
	ServiceName   string
}

// InProcessAnswer handles the taskAnswer.inprocess command from sandbox.
type InProcessAnswer struct {
	Answers         repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	AllowedServices []string
}

// Handle processes inprocess answer update.
func (uc InProcessAnswer) Handle(ctx context.Context, in InProcessAnswerInput) error {
	// Check if service is allowed
	if !uc.isServiceAllowed(in.ServiceName) {
		return domain.ErrForbidden
	}

	// Check user role - must be STUDENT
	if strings.ToUpper(in.UserRole) != "STUDENT" {
		return domain.ErrForbidden
	}

	// Get answer
	answer, err := uc.Answers.GetByID(ctx, in.AnswerID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Check if X-UserId matches answer UserId
	if in.StudentID != answer.StudentID {
		return domain.ErrForbidden
	}

	// Commands must be retry-safe. Already passed answers stay untouched, and a
	// duplicate in-process transition with the same archive pointer becomes a no-op.
	if answer.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed {
		return nil
	}
	if answer.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress && answer.FilestorageID != nil && *answer.FilestorageID == in.FileStorageID {
		return nil
	}
	fileStorageID := &in.FileStorageID
	answer.FilestorageID = fileStorageID
	answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress
	answer.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

	if err := uc.Answers.Update(ctx, *answer); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return nil
}

// isServiceAllowed checks if service is in allowed list.
func (uc InProcessAnswer) isServiceAllowed(serviceName string) bool {
	for _, allowed := range uc.AllowedServices {
		if strings.EqualFold(allowed, serviceName) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
